title: Illegal declaration after statement (procedural block)
manual_summary: Within a procedural block (initial/always/function/task), declarations must appear before executable statements.
fix_guidance: Move all variable declarations to the top of the procedural block, before any assignments, if/case, loops, or delays. In SystemVerilog, you may also declare variables in for-loop headers, but keep style consistent for Questa.
example_before:
always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
  a <= b;
  int i; // illegal here
end

title: Missing semicolon
manual_summary: Most statement and declaration lines in Verilog/SystemVerilog must end with a semicolon.
fix_guidance: Locate the line reported by vlog and add the missing ';'. For module ports, ensure each declaration ends with ';' and that port lists use commas, not semicolons.

title: Unbalanced begin/end
manual_summary: Every begin must have a corresponding end; similarly, case/if/fork blocks must be properly closed.
fix_guidance: Check nested if/case/begin blocks. Indent and add missing end/endcase/endfunction/endmodule as required. Ensure `begin` for an if has an `end` before else/case closure.
example_before:
always_comb begin
  if (a) begin
    y = 1;
end
example_after:
always_comb begin
  if (a) begin
    y = 1;
  end
end

title: Missing endmodule
manual_summary: Each module must be closed with an endmodule keyword.
fix_guidance: Add `endmodule` at the end of the module definition. Verify there are no stray `module` keywords and that file contains exactly one top-level module if expected.

title: Port list/ANSI style mismatch
error_patterns: Number of port connections does not match
manual_summary: Module header port list must match port declarations and instantiation connections in count, order (for positional), and names (for named).
fix_guidance: Prefer ANSI-style: declare direction/type in the module port list. Ensure every port in header has a direction and type (logic/wire) and widths match the interface definition. Fix instantiations to use named connections to avoid ordering issues.

title: Undeclared identifier / signal not declared
manual_summary: All signals, types, parameters, and functions must be declared before use and within scope.
fix_guidance: Declare the missing signal with the correct type and width. If it should be a module port, add it to the port list and update testbench connections. For regs in combinational logic, use logic.

title: Net/reg/logic assignment mismatch (continuous vs procedural)
manual_summary: Continuous assignments (assign) drive nets; procedural assignments drive variables (logic/reg).
fix_guidance: If assigned in always_ff/always_comb, declare as logic (variable). If driven by `assign`, declare as wire (net) or keep logic but drive it procedurally only. Avoid multiple drivers.

title: Multiple drivers / multiple continuous assignments
manual_summary: A signal must not be driven by more than one source unless explicitly resolved (tri, wand).
fix_guidance: Ensure a signal is assigned in only one always block or one continuous assignment. Merge logic or use separate intermediate signals and combine with a single assignment.

title: Always_ff/always_comb misuse
manual_summary: SystemVerilog always_ff is for sequential logic (<=, single clock+optional reset). always_comb is for combinational logic (=, no event control).
fix_guidance: Use always_ff @(posedge clk) with nonblocking assignments for flops. Use always_comb with blocking assignments and include default assignments to avoid latches.

title: Latch inferred in always_comb
manual_summary: Combinational blocks must assign outputs on all paths to avoid latches.
fix_guidance: Provide default assignments at top of always_comb, or cover all branches of if/case with assignments. Ensure case has default.

title: Case statement missing endcase/default
manual_summary: case statements must end with endcase; include a default to cover unspecified items.
fix_guidance: Add missing endcase and a default branch. For unique/priority case, ensure items are mutually exclusive.

title: Generate block syntax error
manual_summary: generate/endgenerate must wrap generate constructs; genvar and for-generate syntax must be correct.
fix_guidance: Use: genvar i; generate for(i=0;i<N;i++) begin: GEN ... end endgenerate. Declare genvar outside procedural blocks.

title: Function/task return/type syntax error
manual_summary: Functions/tasks require correct header, argument list, and closing keyword.
fix_guidance: Ensure `function automatic <type> name(args);` declarations precede statements, include return assignment or `return`, and close with `endfunction`.

title: Package/import syntax error
manual_summary: Packages must be defined/compiled before use; imports must be in correct scope.
fix_guidance: Compile packages first, then `import pkg::*;` in modules/files. Add missing `endpackage` and ensure package name matches.

title: Interface/modport syntax error
manual_summary: Interfaces require endinterface; modports must list directions and signals.
fix_guidance: Define interface in a separate file compiled first. Use `modport master (output ..., input ...);` and reference as `ifc.master`.

title: Parameter/localparam syntax error
manual_summary: Parameters must be constant expressions; parameter lists use #(...).
fix_guidance: Fix parameter declaration syntax, ensure commas, proper types, and that overrides match names/types.

title: Generate if/case constant expression error
manual_summary: Generate conditions and loop bounds must be constant at elaboration.
fix_guidance: Replace runtime signals with parameters/localparams in generate conditions; move conditional logic into always blocks if runtime.

title: Illegal part-select / range
manual_summary: Bit/part selects must be within declared width; some contexts require constant ranges.
fix_guidance: Fix vector widths, adjust indices, or use variable part-select `base +: width` / `base -: width` with valid bounds.

title: Concatenation/replication syntax error
manual_summary: Concats use `{a,b}` and replication uses `{N{a}}` with constant N.
fix_guidance: Ensure braces match and replication count is constant integer. Add missing braces or commas.

title: Numeric literal/base syntax error
manual_summary: Verilog numbers use `<width>'[s]?[bodh]<digits>`; underscores allowed.
fix_guidance: Fix width/base specifier, remove invalid characters, and ensure hex digits are valid for base.

title: String/escape syntax error
manual_summary: Strings must be quoted and may need escaping.
fix_guidance: Close quotes, escape backslashes/quotes, and avoid non-ASCII characters in identifiers if tool chokes.

title: Preprocessor directive error (`define/`include)
manual_summary: Questa preprocesses `define/`include; missing includes or macro definitions cause errors.
fix_guidance: Ensure include paths (-incdir) are set, files exist, and macros are defined before use. Avoid relying on implicit includes.

title: Timescale directive placement
manual_summary: `timescale must appear before any module definitions in a compilation unit.
fix_guidance: Place `timescale 1ns/1ps at the top of the file before module/package/interface declarations.

title: Duplicate declaration
manual_summary: Identifiers cannot be declared twice in the same scope.
fix_guidance: Rename one of the declarations or remove the duplicate. Use unique genblock labels and avoid redeclaring ports as internal signals.

title: Illegal assign in always block
error_patterns: Continuous assignment not allowed in procedural
manual_summary: The `assign` keyword is for continuous assignments, not inside procedural blocks.
fix_guidance: Move `assign` statements out of always blocks, or replace with procedural assignments to a logic variable.

title: Missing sensitivity list / event control
manual_summary: always blocks require an event control; always_comb/always_ff encapsulate this.
fix_guidance: Use always_comb for combinational logic or always_ff for sequential. For Verilog always, add @(...) or @*.

title: Nonblocking assignment in combinational block
manual_summary: Nonblocking assignments are intended for sequential logic; always_comb should use blocking.
fix_guidance: Replace <= with = inside always_comb. If it is sequential, change to always_ff with a clock.

title: Blocking assignment in sequential always_ff
manual_summary: always_ff should use nonblocking assignments.
fix_guidance: Replace = with <= for registers, and keep combinational calculations in separate always_comb or continuous assignments.

title: Implicit wire not allowed / default_nettype none
manual_summary: With `default_nettype none, undeclared nets are errors.
fix_guidance: Declare all wires/logic explicitly. If using default_nettype none, keep it and fix declarations; otherwise you may set `default_nettype wire (not recommended).

title: Module name/file mismatch or duplicate module
manual_summary: Defining the same module name multiple times across files causes conflicts.
fix_guidance: Ensure each compilation unit defines the module only once. Rename modules per round (aesX_r) if needed, or compile only intended file.

title: Reserved keyword used as identifier
manual_summary: SystemVerilog keywords cannot be used as signal/module names without escaping.
fix_guidance: Rename the identifier (e.g., `type`, `logic`, `interface`) or escape with backslash (discouraged).

title: Unconnected ports / missing connections in instance
manual_summary: Instances should connect all required ports; some may be left unconnected intentionally.
fix_guidance: Use named port connections and connect or tie-off unused ports with '0. Ensure interface ports use correct modport.

title: Illegal hierarchical reference
manual_summary: Hierarchical references must match actual instance names and be within scope.
fix_guidance: Avoid hierarchical references in synthesizable DUT. Pass signals through ports instead.

title: Type mismatch in assignment/connection
manual_summary: Assignments and port connections require compatible types and widths.
fix_guidance: Cast types if needed (e.g., logic signed/unsigned), adjust widths with slicing/extension, and ensure packed/unpacked dimensions match.

title: Packed vs unpacked array syntax error
manual_summary: Packed dimensions go before variable name; unpacked after name.
fix_guidance: Use: logic [W-1:0] a [N]; for unpacked. For packed array: logic [N-1:0][W-1:0] a;

title: Struct/union syntax error
manual_summary: struct/union need typedef and proper closing.
fix_guidance: Use: typedef struct packed { ... } name_t; and end with }; Ensure packed keyword for bit-level.

title: Enum syntax error
manual_summary: Enums require a base type and braces.
fix_guidance: Use: typedef enum logic [1:0] {S0,S1,S2,S3} state_t; and declare state_t state;

title: Always block without begin/end for multiple statements
manual_summary: If/else or always blocks with multiple statements need begin/end.
fix_guidance: Wrap multiple statements inside begin/end blocks for if/else/always.

title: For-loop syntax error
manual_summary: for loops need proper init/cond/incr; loop variable must be declared.
fix_guidance: Declare int i; before loop (or in header for SV), ensure semicolons inside for header.

title: Generate for-loop label missing
manual_summary: Some tools require named generate blocks for hierarchical uniqueness.
fix_guidance: Add begin: GEN_i labels to generate blocks. Ensure labels are unique.

title: Incorrect use of <= in assign
manual_summary: Nonblocking <= is not valid in continuous assignments.
fix_guidance: Use '=' for procedural, or 'assign y = expr;' for continuous.

title: Incorrect use of assign to reg in Verilog-2001
manual_summary: In pure Verilog, regs cannot be driven by assign; in SV, logic can be driven but avoid conflicts.
fix_guidance: Declare the target as wire for assign, or drive it procedurally as reg/logic.

title: Sensitivity list missing signal
manual_summary: In Verilog always @(...), missing signals can cause simulation mismatch; always_comb avoids this.
fix_guidance: Use always_comb or always @* for combinational blocks.

title: Illegal use of $clog2 or system function
manual_summary: System functions require SystemVerilog mode and correct syntax.
fix_guidance: Ensure file extension .sv and compiled with SystemVerilog enabled (vlog -sv). Use integer localparam for $clog2 results.

title: Include guard / multiple include
manual_summary: Including headers multiple times can cause redefinitions.
fix_guidance: Add `ifndef/`define include guards to SV headers, or avoid including same file multiple times.

title: Signedness mismatch / arithmetic width
manual_summary: Arithmetic may sign-extend unexpectedly if signedness differs.
fix_guidance: Declare signals as signed where needed, cast with $signed/$unsigned, and size intermediate results.

title: Illegal cast syntax
manual_summary: Casts use type'(expr) in SV.
fix_guidance: Use: logic [7:0] a; int b; a = logic'(b[7:0]); Ensure parentheses and quote are correct.

title: Delay/control not allowed in synthesizable always_ff
manual_summary: Delays (#) are not synthesizable and may be disallowed in some contexts.
fix_guidance: Remove delays and model timing with clocked logic. In testbench-only code, keep delays out of DUT.

title: Illegal use of initial in synthesizable DUT (policy)
manual_summary: Some flows disallow initial blocks in DUT.
fix_guidance: Move initialization into reset logic in always_ff with synchronous reset.

title: Missing reset handling
manual_summary: Uninitialized regs cause Xs; some tests assume reset behavior.
fix_guidance: Add synchronous reset branch in always_ff, set outputs/state to known values.

title: Incorrect always_ff reset edge
manual_summary: always_ff may allow async resets but require a consistent event expression.
fix_guidance: Use either synchronous reset in body (if (rst)) with posedge clk only, or async reset with @(posedge clk or posedge rst) and keep style consistent.

title: Invalid interface port connection syntax
manual_summary: Interface ports connect by passing the interface instance, not individual signals.
fix_guidance: Instantiate interface in top and connect: .s_in(s_in) where s_in is an interface instance with correct modport. Do not connect s_in.tdata directly to interface port.

title: Modport direction conflict
manual_summary: Connecting a modport with wrong direction causes errors.
fix_guidance: Use correct modport (master/slave) as defined. If module expects slave, connect slave view of interface.

title: Unresolved `include path (incdir)
manual_summary: Missing -incdir leads to include failures.
fix_guidance: Add include directory in sim.py/vlog command or move included file into src dir; avoid absolute includes.

title: Compilation order dependency
manual_summary: Questa requires packages/interfaces/typedefs to be compiled before modules using them.
fix_guidance: Ensure vlog compiles common files (interfaces/packages) first, then the DUT and testbench.

title: Illegal use of automatic/static
manual_summary: automatic can apply to functions/tasks; static to variables. Wrong placement causes syntax errors.
fix_guidance: Use `function automatic` or `task automatic`. For variables, use `static` inside class or function as allowed.

title: Class syntax error
manual_summary: Classes are for testbench; DUT should avoid classes.
fix_guidance: Remove class constructs from DUT; if needed for TB, ensure endclass and correct syntax.

title: Property/assert syntax error
manual_summary: Assertions require proper property/sequence syntax.
fix_guidance: Remove assertions from DUT if not needed, or fix property/sequence blocks and compile with SV assertions enabled.

title: `default_nettype directive misuse
manual_summary: `default_nettype must be standalone directive and reset at end if used.
fix_guidance: Place `default_nettype none at top, and restore `default_nettype wire at end of file if necessary.

title: Operator precedence / missing parentheses
manual_summary: Complex expressions may require parentheses, and some operators need specific operands.
fix_guidance: Add parentheses, ensure ternary has both ':' and '?', and fix missing operands.

title: Ternary operator missing ':'
manual_summary: The conditional operator requires both true and false expressions: cond ? a : b.
fix_guidance: Add missing ':' branch, ensure widths match between branches.

title: Comma/parenthesis mismatch in port list
manual_summary: Port lists require proper comma separation and balanced parentheses.
fix_guidance: Fix commas between ports, remove trailing commas if tool disallows, and balance parentheses.

title: Invalid DPI-C import/export syntax
manual_summary: DPI is TB-oriented; wrong syntax triggers errors.
fix_guidance: Remove DPI from DUT. If required, use correct SV DPI syntax and compile with DPI enabled.

title: Invalid attribute syntax
manual_summary: Attributes use (* ... *) and must be placed correctly.
fix_guidance: Fix attribute delimiters and placement (before declarations/instances). Remove unknown attributes if unnecessary.
